summary: Regenerate the plan with pointer-event resizing, bounded and clamped layout dimensions, and drag-safe accessible header controls.

requiredChanges.title: Use Pointer Events for docked resizing
requiredChanges.description: Replace mouse-only listeners with pointerdown, pointermove, pointerup and pointercancel, supporting mouse, touch and pen with cleanup on completion, cancellation and unmount.

requiredChanges.title: Add dynamic maximum dimensions and clamp restored layout
requiredChanges.description: Define maximum width and height constraints, preserve usable main-content width in docked mode, and clamp width, height, x and y on restoration and viewport resize.

requiredChanges.title: Prevent controls from initiating drag and add accessible labels
requiredChanges.description: Use a dedicated drag handle or react-rnd cancel selector for interactive controls and add explicit aria-label values to icon-only actions.
